journeys.name: Search noise cancelling headphones and verify first product detail page
journeys.user_goal: Search for 'noise cancelling headphones', open the first organic product result and confirm the product title, price and Add to Cart button are visible
preconditions: Public internet access; no login required
No robot-check/captcha interstitial (if one appears, test must fail as BLOCKED, never bypass)
journeys.no_forms_reason: Read-only verification journey. The only input is the single search box submitted via Enter; no multi-field form or dialog is opened, and the Add to Cart button is only asserted visible, never clicked.

steps.observable_result: Home page rendered with the search box visible; no captcha interstitial observed in this session.

steps.action: Fill the searchbox with 'noise cancelling headphones' and press Enter
Click the title link (h2 anchor) of the first organic (non-Sponsored) result card
steps.element: locator('[data-component-type="s-search-result"]').filter({ hasNotText: 'Sponsored' }).first() -> inner h2 link (a:has(h2)); link may have target=_blank and open a new tab/popup — test must handle or strip it
steps.observable_result: First organic result observed: ASIN B0BS74M665, 'Sony WH-CH720N Active Noise Cancellation Wireless Bluetooth Over Ear Headphones...'; navigated to /Sony-Cancellation-Headphones-Multi-Point-Connection/dp/B0BS74M665/ref=sr_1_1.

steps.element: locator('#productTitle') — a span inside the single page heading; getByRole('heading').filter({ has: locator('#productTitle') }) matched exactly 1
steps.observable_result: Title visible: 'Sony WH-CH720N Active Noise Cancellation Wireless Bluetooth Over Ear Headphones with Mic, Adaptive S...' (offsetParent !== null).

steps.element: locator('#corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div .a-price-whole') with sibling .a-price-symbol; note: .a-price .a-offscreen textContent is EMPTY on this page — do not assert on .a-offscreen

steps.action: Verify Add to Cart button is visible (DO NOT click)
steps.element: getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart', exact: true }) — matched exactly 1 (input#add-to-cart-button, value 'Add to cart', aria-labelledby submit.add-to-cart-announce). Non-exact name also matches a hidden shortcuts-menu button 'Add to cart, shift, option, K', so exact: true is required
steps.observable_result: Add to Cart button visible (isVisible() === true).

evidence_notes: Live exploration 2026-11-24 ~19:25 IST via playwright-cli chromium; all locator facts verified with targeted eval/run-code checks (atcExactCount=1, titleHeading=1, atcVisible=true, price whole '7,989' symbol '₹').
caveats: Amazon result order is dynamic; the 'first organic product' changes between sessions. Assert generic visibility, not the Sony-specific title text.
Anti-bot: after goto, check body text for /robot check|captcha|type the characters|verify you are human/i and fail BLOCKED if matched.
Product title link can open in a new tab (target=_blank) depending on card template; handle popup or use the href navigation.

journeys.name: Search mechanical keyboard, apply four-star filter, and verify first product
journeys.user_goal: Search for 'mechanical keyboard', apply the '4 Stars & Up' customer review filter, open the first organic result, and verify the product title, price, and Add to Cart button are visible.
preconditions: Public internet access; no login required
No robot-check/captcha interstitial (if one appears, stop and do not bypass)
journeys.no_forms_reason: Read-only journey. Search is submitted from the single search box; the review refinement is a navigation link. Add to Cart is verified visible and never clicked.

steps.observable_result: Page title was Amazon.in; #twotabsearchtextbox was present; robot-check/captcha/access-denied text was absent.

steps.action: Fill the searchbox with 'mechanical keyboard' and press Enter
steps.observable_result: Results URL was https://www.amazon.in/s?k=mechanical+keyboard&ref=nb_sb_noss; 16 result cards matched [data-component-type="s-search-result"].

steps.action: Apply the '4 Stars & Up' option in Customer Reviews
steps.element: locator('#reviewsRefinements').getByRole('link', { name: '4 Stars & Up' }); live DOM link href included rh=p_72%3A1318476031 and the visible link text was '4 Stars & Up'.
steps.observable_result: Clicking the review link changed the URL to include rh=p_72%3A1318476031; the document title became 'Amazon.in: Mechanical Keyboard - 4 Stars & Up'.

steps.action: Open the title link of the first organic (non-Sponsored) result
steps.observable_result: First organic result was 'EvoFox Fireblade TKL Semi-Mechanical Gaming Keyboard with Rainbow Backlit& Breathing Effect, Floating Keycaps, 19 Anti-Ghosting & 12 Multimedia Keys, Windows Lock Key, Braided Cable (Black)' (4.1 stars). It opened ASIN B085366TJW in a new tab.

steps.action: Verify product title, price, and Add to Cart button are visible (do not click Add to Cart)
steps.element: locator('#productTitle'); locator('#corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div .a-price-whole').first() and sibling .a-price-symbol; getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart', exact: true }).
steps.observable_result: Title was visible and non-empty; visible price was ₹899; exact Add to cart button was visible. No access barrier was present.

evidence_notes: Direct targeted Playwright CLI verification on 2026-11-24. Only the four requested user actions were explored. Add to Cart was not clicked.
caveats: Search result order and prices can change; tests must assert visible, non-empty title and numeric price rather than fixed product or price values.
The first organic product title link opened a new tab in this run; handle the popup.
If an anti-bot or access barrier appears, stop and fail clearly; never bypass it.

journeys.name: Search portable SSD 1TB, open first non-sponsored PDP, add to cart and verify confirmation
journeys.user_goal: Find a 1TB portable SSD, open its product page, verify title/price, add it to the cart and see confirmation (REQ-AMZ-04 / C9078561)
journeys.starting_point: https://www.amazon.in (clean session, no login, empty cart)
journeys.preconditions: Clean browser session without user login; cart count 0
journeys.data_requirements: Search query 'portable ssd 1tb'; no account or test data needed
journeys.no_forms_reason: Add to Cart is a single button click with no input fields; the search box is a single query field covered in steps, not a multi-field form

steps.observable_result: Home page rendered with the search box visible; no captcha interstitial observed in this session.

steps.action: Fill search box with 'portable ssd 1tb' and press Enter
Click product link of first non-sponsored result
steps.observable_result: Link had target=_blank and opened PDP in a popup page; PDP URL matched /\/dp\// (observed https://www.amazon.in/SanDisk-Portable-.../dp/B0F63CGD8B/...). Popup must be handled via page.waitForEvent('popup').

Title visible and non-empty ('SANDISK Extreme 1TB Portable External SSD...'). IMPORTANT: bare #productTitle is a STRICT-MODE VIOLATION on this PDP (span + hidden input[name=productTitle] both match); use span#productTitle.
Price whole '19,999' (digits with comma) and symbol '₹' visible. Never use .a-offscreen.

steps.element: getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart', exact: true }) (input#add-to-cart-button); #nav-cart-count was '0' before click
steps.observable_result: Click succeeded; page NAVIGATED (same page object) to cart confirmation URL https://www.amazon.in/cart/smart-wagon?newItems=<uuid>,1&ref_=sw_refresh

steps.element: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Added to cart' }) (level 1) and locator('#nav-cart-count')
steps.observable_result: Heading 'Added to cart' visible with product image and 'Color: Royal Blue' detail; #nav-cart-count text became '1'. URL pattern /\/cart\/smart-wagon/ is a reliable confirmation signal.

evidence_notes: Live verification run 2026-11-25 13:35 IST via playwright-cli session amz (RUN-20261125-132600).

Add to Cart click observed to navigate in-place to /cart/smart-wagon?newItems=... — NOT a side-sheet on this flow; assert URL /\/cart\/smart-wagon/, heading 'Added to cart', and #nav-cart-count == '1'.
No CAPTCHA/robot-check/consent interstitial encountered during this session.
caveats: PDP link opens popup (target=_blank): all PDP assertions must run on the popup page object; the add-to-cart navigation happens on that popup page.
Cart confirmation may alternatively render as a side-sheet in some sessions; primary verified signal is the smart-wagon page with Added to cart heading + cart count 1.

frontier.element: Add to Cart click / cart flow
frontier.reason_not_visited: Out of scope: read-only verification; mutating a public retail cart is not authorized.

exploration_limits: Single journey scoped to the requested scenario; public site, unauthenticated, read-only.
observations: amazon.in PDP: #productTitle, visible price via #corePriceDisplay_desktop_feature_div .a-price-whole and .a-price-symbol, Add to Cart via getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart', exact: true }). The 4 Stars & Up customer review link is under #reviewsRefinements with href filter rh=p_72%3A1318476031.
